rules.name: Spec
rules.says: The guard starts ready, decides one request, and returns to ready before deciding another.

rules.name: TypeOK
rules.says: The state is ready with no request, or holds one bounded request and its NextResponse.next() or HTTP 403 result.

rules.name: SafeMethodsPass
rules.says: GET, HEAD and OPTIONS pass regardless of their headers.

rules.name: UntrustedHostsRefused
rules.says: Every other method receives 403 unless Host names a local address or a hostname in ASK3D_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

rules.name: CrossSiteRefused
rules.says: Every other method receives 403 when a nonempty Sec-Fetch-Site is neither same-origin nor none.

rules.name: MismatchedOriginRefused
rules.says: Every other method receives 403 when a valid nonempty Origin has a URL host that differs from the raw Host header, including case and port.

rules.name: MalformedOriginRefused
rules.says: Every other method receives 403 when a nonempty Origin cannot be parsed as a URL.

rules.name: AcceptedRequestsPass
rules.says: A request passes when its Host is local or listed, Sec-Fetch-Site is absent, empty, same-origin or none, and Origin is absent, empty or has exactly the same URL host as Host.

rules.name: LocalCurlPasses
rules.says: A POST to localhost:3000 with neither browser header can pass.

rules.name: RebindingRefused
rules.says: A POST to evil.example:3000 can receive 403 even with same-origin Sec-Fetch-Site and its own Origin.

rules.name: SkipHostCheck
rules.says: A faulty guard passes a request from an untrusted Host because its browser headers are acceptable.

rules.name: IgnoreCrossSite
rules.says: A faulty guard passes a cross-site request to an allowed Host because its Origin matches.

count_meanings.chart_states: Partitions by reader label and violated invariant set, including all concrete states.
count_meanings.hidden_steps: Concrete step occurrences belonging to fully hidden arrows.
count_meanings.shown_steps: Concrete step occurrences belonging to visible arrows.
count_meanings.tlc_generated_states: TLC generated states: initial generation (including duplicates) plus dumped step occurrences.
count_meanings.tlc_states: Distinct reachable concrete states in the complete TLC graph.
count_meanings.tlc_steps: Dumped concrete step occurrences, including duplicates and self-loops.
